# ✨ Feature Request

## 📌 Summary

Provide a short and clear description of the feature.

---

## 🎯 Problem Statement

Describe the problem you're trying to solve.

Example:

> I frequently need to monitor multiple serial devices at the same time, but switching between terminals is difficult.

---

## 💡 Proposed Solution

Describe your proposed solution.

Example:

> Add support for multiple serial tabs with synchronized timestamps.

---

## 🔄 Alternative Solutions

Describe any alternative solutions or workarounds you've considered.

---

## 🎨 Mockups / References

If applicable, attach:

- Screenshots
- UI mockups
- Diagrams
- Links to similar implementations

---

## 📈 Benefits

How would this feature improve Open Device Studio?

Examples:

- Improve productivity
- Reduce development time
- Better debugging
- Better user experience
- Easier device management

---
